title: Bake & Mystery Challenge
meta: About 45–50 min, plus each extra oven load

blocks.title: Safety first
blocks.text: Check your school’s food requirements and every student’s allergies and dietary needs against each ingredient label, including any Mystery ingredient. Only adults handle the oven and hot pans.

items: Book the oven and an adult for the whole session. Check how many pans fit at once: each extra load adds 20–25 min
Confirm whether students may eat what they bake, and when; cupcakes won’t be cool by the end of the session
Shop from the recipe card: one recipe per team makes about 12–18 standard cupcakes
Give each team its own bowl, square pan (recipe step 3), measuring cups and spoons, fork and cupcake pan; shared tools cause most delays
Put liners in the pans and label each pan with its team’s name
Hand-washing and cleaning supplies, oven mitts, warm water, and a spot out of reach for hot pans to cool
Mystery: choose one twist (below) and set it out before class

items.title: Roles
items.text: An adult switches the oven to 350°F (175°C) now; it takes 10–15 min to heat. Teams pick roles: Leader, Reader, Ingredient Manager, Mixer, Timekeeper, Clean-Up Crew. Small teams combine roles. Everyone washes hands.

items.title: Measure and mix
items.text: Mystery: reveal the twist first. Teams follow the recipe, level off dry measures, and fill liners about ¾ full. Finished teams wait at their station, not at the oven.

items.title: Bake
items.text: An adult loads and unloads the oven and checks with a toothpick at 20 min. Teams wash up while they wait. Hot pans go straight to the cooling spot.
Halfway through mixing, every student takes a new role.
Remove one mixing tool; never oven mitts or safety equipment.
Only after the allergy check above; set out one portion per team.
Only if teams decorate in a later session, once the cupcakes are cool.

items: Students follow their roles and support each other.
Mystery: teams adapt to the twist without unapproved ingredients.
